name: fleet
description: A side pane with this session's subagents, background shells and the repo's worktrees, with alerts when they finish or fail.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the fleet pane when 2 or more agents run at once (unasked panes need a terminal 144 columns wide); /fleet opens it any time

sound.title: Sound on failure and all done
sound.description: A short chime (paplay with the freedesktop sounds) when an agent or shell fails, and when everything has finished

telegram.title: Telegram summary when away
telegram.description: Send an all-done summary through telegram-notifier's bot (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID) when you have not typed for idleMinutes

idleMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: How long since your last prompt before the Telegram summary is sent
